templates.title: PodFetch
templates.name: podfetch
templates.description: PodFetch is a sleek and efficient self-hosted podcast manager written in Rust. It automatically downloads new episodes, offers a web UI for listening and managing podcasts, and provides a GPodder-compatible sync API so you can keep using podcast apps like AntennaPod.
templates.note: Sleek podcast downloader with GPodder sync

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.label: DATABASE_URL
env.description: SQLite database location (or a PostgreSQL connection string)

env.name: POLLING_INTERVAL
env.label: POLLING_INTERVAL
env.description: Minutes between checks for new episodes

env.name: BASIC_AUTH
env.label: BASIC_AUTH
env.description: Set to true to enable login (required for GPodder sync); also set USERNAME and PASSWORD

env.name: USERNAME
env.label: USERNAME
env.description: Admin username when BASIC_AUTH is enabled

env.name: PASSWORD
env.label: PASSWORD
env.description: Admin password when BASIC_AUTH is enabled

env.name: GPODDER_INTEGRATION_ENABLED
env.label: GPODDER_INTEGRATION_ENABLED
env.description: Set to true to enable the GPodder-compatible sync API for apps like AntennaPod
